# Press Escape to dismiss focused global search when no overlay is active

> Prove Escape clears the active global search focus state when the field is focused and no search overlay is open, following the recommended branch of the unresolved Escape rule.

## Step 1

Open {{start_url}} in a desktop browser and wait until the terminal header is visible with the centered global search field present.

## Step 2

Focus the global search field from the header without entering text, and confirm no search overlay is visible before dismissal is attempted.

## Step 3

Store the focused field state with no visible search overlay as escape_focus_baseline before pressing Escape.

## Step 4

Press Escape once while the global search field is focused and no search overlay is visible.

## Step 5

Assert the global search field is no longer focused and no search overlay is shown after the keypress.

## Step 6 — assert @verifies ac-165

Confirm state-transition check: global search field not focused (equals) — the stated promise: When the global search field is focused and no search overlay is active, pressing Escape clears focus from the field.
